app.tagline: Draw strings of light in the air. Then play them.
app.privacy: Your camera never leaves this device. Nothing is uploaded.
status.ready: Show your hand to the camera
error.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's address bar, or play with touch.
error.noCamera: No camera found. You can still play with touch or mouse.
error.tracking: Hand tracking could not start on this device. Touch mode is on.
error.audio: Audio could not start. Tap the screen and try again.
error.webgl: Your browser has no WebGL2, so Strandlight runs in light mode.
error.midi: Web MIDI works only in Chrome and Edge.
error.sceneInvalid: This scene file could not be read.
settings.title: Settings
mode.beginner.hint: No wrong notes. Every string fits the scale.
mode.musician.hint: Scales, looper, pitch bend and sustain.
mode.virtuoso.hint: Chromatic tuning, velocity, MIDI and OSC.
settings.harpPreset.hint: Draws parallel strings in diatonic order.
settings.privacy: Camera frames and hand points are processed on this device only.
looper.idle: Press Space to record a loop
looper.recording: Recording… Space to close the loop
looper.playing: Looping {layers, plural, one {# layer} other {# layers}} · Space to overdub
guide.step1: Show your hand. Your fingertips will light up.
guide.step2: Pinch your thumb and index finger, then pull.
guide.step3: Let go. The string stays in the air.
guide.step4: Sweep your finger across the string.
guide.touch2: Press and hold, then drag to draw a string.
guide.touch4: Swipe quickly across a string to play it.
help.title: How to play
help.draw: Pinch and pull to draw a string. Let go to place it.
help.pluck: Sweep your index finger across a string. Faster is louder.
help.flick: Flick fast near a string to send sparks along it.
help.stretch: Pinch the end of a string to move or stretch it (Musician and Virtuoso).
help.fist: Make a fist to mute everything.
help.palm: Hold an open palm for a second to add sustain.
help.pad: Show both hands to play a chord between your fingertips.
help.length: Short strings ring like glass, medium ones like a harp, long ones like a bass.
app.author: Designed & built by {name}
about.title: About
about.bio: I design products and build them with AI agents: spec first, decisions with reasons, every line reviewed, security from day one.
about.project: Strandlight started with one question: what if you could build an instrument out of light, with nothing but your hands? It runs entirely in your browser, and your camera never leaves your device.
